keep_features.feature_value: Mentions touching children's genitals / grooming children
keep_features.rationale: The text directly accuses/frames conduct as sexual abuse of children.

keep_features.feature_value: Uses strong profanity toward Supreme Court
keep_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity (fucking) used for emphasis.

keep_features.feature_value: Media hosts (Fox News / MSNBC) framed as partisan mouthpieces in foreign policy
keep_features.rationale: Targets specific media personalities as influencing war/foreign policy decisions.

keep_features.feature_value: Mirror flips blame from Fox/Republicans to MSNBC/Democrats for foreign policy meddling
keep_features.evidence_span: "Fox News host" ... "not involved in war decisions" vs "MSNBC mouthpiece" ... "isn't whispering in Biden's ear"
keep_features.rationale: The mirror replaces the criticized party/actor with the opposite side while keeping the same accusation pattern.

keep_features.feature_value: Christians called to fight to abolish abortion after Roe overturn
keep_features.evidence_span: "June is life month" ... "Christians need to fight" "abolish" abortion
keep_features.rationale: Links a religious group to an abortion policy goal following Roe v. Wade overturn.

keep_features.feature_value: Uses moral/ethical framing about unborn life vs eliminating it
keep_features.evidence_span: "an unborn child's life deserves protection" / "not eliminating one"
keep_features.rationale: The mirror employs deontic moral language (deserves protection, should be fighting).

keep_features.feature_value: Prescribes electing majorities and enforcing law on fossil fuel industry/oil companies; renewable energy
keep_features.evidence_span: "Electing pro-science Democratic majorities, enforcing law on fossil fuel industry/oil companies, renewable energy all KEY"

keep_features.feature_value: Conditional question about why tariffs subsidies were ignored, plus NAFTA historical reference
keep_features.evidence_span: "Why when discussing Trump’s tariffs were subsidies completely ignored" ... "When NAFTA was negotiated"
keep_features.rationale: Uses contrastive conditional inquiry (why … ignored) and references a prior negotiation event (NAFTA).

remove_features.feature_value: Threatening violent phrasing about beating AOC
remove_features.rationale: Expresses intent for violence as part of the message.

remove_features.feature_value: Dehumanizes supporters and labels them bots/shills; suggests silencing/drowning out
remove_features.evidence_span: "MAGAts are morons" ... "Just beat them with better propaganda" / "drown them out"
remove_features.rationale: Creates an in-group/out-group contrast and prescribes propagandistic exclusion.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses profanity ('fuck off') directed at an education secretary/union
remove_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity used as a dismissive command.

remove_features.feature_value: Rhetorical legal syllogism: murder law -> abortion against the law because murder
remove_features.evidence_span: "Murder is against the law" ... "Therefore Abortion is indeed against the law"
remove_features.rationale: Presents structured reasoning with definitive claims and a drawn conclusion.

remove_features.feature_value: Blasphemous/occult rhetoric labeling Planned Parenthood as 'devil' and using Satan/sacrifice imagery
remove_features.evidence_span: "Satan loves abortion" ... "Planned Parenthood is the devil’s favorite business"
remove_features.rationale: Uses explicit religious demonization and extreme imagery to characterize an organization.

remove_features.feature_value: Attributes immigration/population anxiety to ISIS/Iraq/Syria and implies causal manipulation in mirror
remove_features.evidence_span: "mostly due to Iraq and ISIS" / mirror: "manufactured outrage" "Fox News panic and MAGA hysteria"
remove_features.rationale: Frames demographic change and reactions as driven by militant actors (original) and as manufactured/inflated (mirror).

remove_features.feature_value: Direct second-person interrogatives about presidential immunity/investigation
remove_features.evidence_span: "Do you care if the president... immune from investigation forever?"
remove_features.rationale: Uses direct 'Do you' question addressing the reader.
